question: Who is elected as the first woman member of Rajya Sabha in India from Nagaland in April 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Phangnon Konyak.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Phangnon Konyak is elected as the first woman member of Rajya Sabha in India from Nagaland in April 2022.
 
• She is a member of the Nationalist Democratic Progressive Party (NDPP) and was elected unopposed to the Rajya Sabha.
 
• Miriam Rengma is not the correct answer as she is not a member of the Rajya Sabha.
 
• Jesmina Zeliang is also not the correct answer as she is not the first woman member of Rajya Sabha from Nagaland.
 
• Priyanka Gandhi is not the correct answer as she is not a member of Rajya Sabha from Nagaland.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Phangnon Konyak is a prominent political figure in Nagaland and has been associated with the NDPP since its inception in 2018.
 
• Miriam Rengma is a social activist from Nagaland and has been working for the welfare of women and children in the state.
 
• Jesmina Zeliang is a former member of the Nagaland Legislative Assembly and has been associated with the Naga People's Front (NPF).
 
• Priyanka Gandhi is a member of the Indian National Congress and is currently serving as the General Secretary of the party. However, she is not a member of Rajya Sabha from Nagaland.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1 - Phangnon Konyak
